actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Residents 3 and 5 contributed over 30 units last round; punish Resident5 with maximum severity affordable and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow rules. In last round (4) contributions: Resident3 contributed 38.83 >30, Resident5 contributed 114.14 >30. Any other >30? Yes both. Rule: "If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with the maximum severity you can afford (severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost))." It says any other resident, but we can only punish one? Probably we can choose one target. Choose any with >30. Could punish Resident5 (largest). Compute max severity: wallet 38.28 /0.3 =127.6 floor 127. So severity 127. Cost = severity * punishment_cost = 127*0.3 = 38.1 which is <= wallet 38.28, affordable. So we can punish Resident5 with 127 severity. Then broadcast message discouraging large contributions.

Return actions list with punish and broadcast.
